verdict.rationale: Asking an auth framework or platform for AI-generated insights on its user and auth data, such as security or usage suggestions, is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI insights feature. The hosted MCP server only offers documentation search and setup help, and the MCP plugin provides OAuth for MCP clients; neither produces insights from the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
